answer_1.quote: Large-scale pre-training for dialogue generation has advanced the development of engaging and humanlike dialogue systems.

answer_2.quote: We measure model performance using Accuracy and Macro-F1.

answer_4.quote: All the human annotators were hired from a reputable data annotation company. They were instructed with the annotation procedure and the definitions and examples of contradiction categories.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed with the annotation procedure and the definitions and examples of contradiction categories. Each conversation was annotated by two different annotators. If their results were inconsistent, a third annotator would be asked to re-annotate and discuss the case with the first two annotators to reach a consensus.
